notes:
POC objective: validate Dedicated capacity to satisfy realtime routing SLA (p50/p95 latency) and bulk document embedding throughput for nightly batch jobs. Focus areas: throughput guarantees, latency SLOs, reserved GPU sizing, soak-test stability, and contract SLA language.

Key quotes / sentiment:
- CTO (M. Alvarez): 'We need a predictable tail latency for the routing endpoint — spikes kill our dispatch loops.'
- Platform lead: 'If reserved capacity + autoscale can guarantee p95 < 200ms under 600 concurrent clients we're close.'

Technical acceptance criteria (agreed on 2026-02-18 call):
- Realtime routing endpoint (short prompts ~40–150 tokens): p50 < 30ms, p95 < 200ms for 600 concurrent QPS with 4x batching; sustained 24h.
- Document embedding pipeline: ingest throughput 1M pages/day (approx 250k docs) with end-to-end tokenized throughput target ~120k tokens/s across the reserved pool.
- Soak stability: 72h continuous load with <0.5% error rate, average GPU utilization 60–80%, and no memory OOMs.
- Fallback behavior: automatic fallback to smaller verified model (rw-13b-quant) within 200ms on overload; must preserve structure/labels for routing decisions.

POC test plan (high level):
1) Baseline run on hosted equivalent for workload shape capture (done 2026-01-22) — captured latency histograms, token size distribution.
2) Load test day: ramp to 600 concurrent clients over 30m, hold 4h, collect p50/p90/p95/p99, profiling traces (2026-02-26).
3) Soak test: 72h continuous with periodic microbursts (3x normal) to validate autoscale and cache behavior (proposed 2026-03-15 — pending sign-off).
4) Batch embedding run: push 250k docs in parallel with staggered workers; verify throughput and KV cache warmup curves.
5) Regression checks: 50 golden prompts for routing accuracy pre/post quantization.

Representative prompt samples (short-hand):
- "Route pickup at 1515 S. Market to nearest depot with EV constraints and ETA < 45m" (routing/decision)
- "Extract PO# and ETA from emailed invoice" (NLP extraction)
- Long doc: 3–8 page manifest for embedding and QA retrieval tests.

Reserved GPU planning notes:
- Preliminary sizing from Redwood SE: start with 8x A100 equivalent reserved for steady state with 4x burst GPUs available for peak hour surges (2 small scale policies tested).
- Questions: what is the committed burst pricing? how are preemptible instances handled under the contract?
- Memory footprint: routing model (rw-70b-quant) needs KV cache tuning; SE recommends config with aggressive KV shard pinning for latency.

Observability & telemetry:
- Need token-level cost breakdown per route, per-model latency dash to cross-validate with our tracing.
- Request: include per-instance GPU telemetry and per-request trace ids to correlate timeouts.

Security / compliance notes:
- VPC + private control plane required for initial POC; planning on hybrid (on_prem connectors for sensitive manifests).
- Redwood SOC2 + SAML integration required. Legal wants explicit audit log retention policy (30/90/365 day options).
